feature_graph_contract: No package filter in metadata/catalog/test. Compare the original193 workspace-member and resolved feature/dependency graph exactly. Rebuild the original6 normal helpers in a new exclusive target, then use the full catalog to bind all33 original helper basenames and the original selected App test program to fresh epoch-specific hashes. Require those new hashes stable before/after the test; do not require or claim equality with vanished binaries.

observation.root: Actual original just test PID+starttime recorded immediately after Popen. Seed descendant traversal only while that exact identity still matches; observer PID excluded.
observation.structural_proc_stat: Read pid/comm/state/ppid/pgid/sid/starttime for ancestry; persist only this command's observed descendants.
observation.cmdline_scope: Read bounded 16384B cmdline/exe only for current descendants or identical previously-owned PID/starttime pairs; never read env.
observation.marker_policy: Learn exact codex-command-exec-marker-[0-9]+ only from owned argv. No external ps/pgrep/observer command receives a dynamic marker, avoiding contamination of the original ps oracle.
observation.control: No signal/kill/strace/policy or sandbox changes. Observer failure is recorded; it does not cancel original test.
observation.limitation: A child that detached before first observation can be missed. An isolated PASS is not a fix; preserve the original full failure.
observation.completeness: Requires exactly one actually observed dynamic fixture marker, no observer errors, exact selected JUnit name, and stable source/helpers/program; no marker or multiple markers retain the original test result but diagnose incomplete observation.

stop_conditions: Any source/index/lock/fixture mismatch or nonempty unreviewed untracked source list stops before building/testing.
The new target must not exist or be a symlink. Never clean, rename or write the old target.
Insufficient guarded disk or build/catalog failure stops; retain all actual outputs.
Full original resolved graph and33 helper basename roster must match; all new paths must resolve within the new target.
Exactly one original case with fresh JUnit, original5s budget and zero retries; no assertions or policy changed.
Keep incomplete observation, failed result or child-marker absence as such; an isolated PASS is not a repair.
Stop after the diagnostic, with no hygiene or subsequent test.

authorization.purpose: Resolve the original full-workspace connection-disconnect process-lifetime failure with read-only observations of this invocation's own processes.
authorization.scope: Build only in the new exclusive target after current exact f825/private-index/untracked/ordinary-index/lock/fixture guards. Original6 helper build, full normal metadata/catalog, one original selected App case with unchanged5s oracle and0retry. Observe only this invocation own processes. Keep old target and source unchanged. Stop after terminal for root review.

review_tightening: All prior owned PID/starttime and single-marker observer checks remain.
Source untracked paths checked against the complete private f825 index; no untracked path is pre-authorized.
New build epoch records its own program identity; original missing binary evidence remains unchanged.
